profile.headline: Software Engineer @ VML | Web Developer Certification
profile.summary:
As a software engineer at VML, I specialize in building scalable and clean React Native code for mobile applications, ensuring seamless integration with RESTful APIs and delivering user-centered features in Agile sprints. By leveraging tools like Google Analytics and translating Figma designs into functional interfaces, our team crafts intuitive and high-performing mobile solutions.  

With over 8 years of experience in web and mobile development, my expertise spans React, Node.js, and GraphQL. At Demosphere, I contributed to multi-platform tools and reusable codebases that drove client retention and new business acquisition. My work reflects a commitment to technical excellence and collaboration in delivering impactful, user-friendly applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain clean, scalable React Native code for BHE mobile applications.

Integrate RESTful APIs and resolve complex backend integration issues.

Deliver features iteratively within 2-week sprints, actively collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.

Utilize Google Analytics for user insights and translate Figma designs into fully functional mobile interfaces.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the development of multiple full-stack features utilizing React, Nodejs, GraphQL, MongoDB, and Apollo, and third party libararies such as MUI, Yup, etc., generating millions in revenue by prompting existing clients to renew their contracts and attracting new state clubs to sign with the company.
Shipped fully developed and tested flexible scheduling tools, customized reports, synced calendar process, user customizable forms, along with form versioning that work seamlessly across platforms and devices. 
Built reusable, scalable code, microservices and libraries for future use, ensuring technical feasibility of UX/UI designs and optimized  applications for maximum scalability.
Ensured code performance by writing > 80% integration testing coverage with Jest and Mocha and upgrading back-end node versions with LTS.
Modeled database, wrote queries and mutations, and improved data management efficiency 85% by writing paginated queries and added indexing.
Improved team productivity and reduced friction by implementing a video walkthrough and adding detailed development notes to each JIRA ticket, effectively capturing the implementation scope and limitations.
Trained and mentored new developers, facilitated knowledge transfer and team capability enhancement.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Develop new user-facing features, functionality and ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs
Build reusable code and libraries for future use and write unit and integration tests
Work as part of a team to build React Native iOS / Android application for SaaS product
Architect, build and maintain excellent React Native applications with clean code
Implement clean, modern, smooth animations and transitions that provide an excellent user experience
Release applications to the Apple and Google Play stores
Work with native modules when required
Collaborate with other team members and stakeholders
Follow Agile development methodologies  and continuous delivery processes
Work with modern tools including Jira, Slack, GitHub, Google Docs, etc.
Be part of a community of React Native developers who share knowledge and help each other as problems arise

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Develop new user-facing features and functionality

Remain fervent and sympathetic to the users of our solutions

projects.description: Airbnb clone using Next.JS application, with Clerk authentication and UI components from Shadcn. Data is stored  in database with Prisma and Supabase, along with practice of using server actions.

projects.title: Troo - Shopping Cart
projects.description:
A dairy, snack shopping cart application build with MERN stack with admin section to manage products and checkout section using Paypal's API (in progress).

The application uses NodeJS, Express, and Mongoose, MongoDB for server side, and React, HTML, CSS for client side. All authenticated users are able to add items to shopping cart, find products with different filters. Only admin is able to add new products to the site, manage categories to the application.

GitHub's link: https://github.com/ngthu1995/troo
